property_summary: The owner should always be able to withdraw all funds from the contract.
Only the original owner can successfully call withdrawAll; an unauthorized caller (address zero) should revert.
The contract's balance after calling withdrawAll with the owner as recipient should always be zero when the contract has a positive balance.
A non-owner caller (address(this)) can still successfully call withdrawAll and the contract balance decreases if any non-zero amount was present.
Only the owner can successfully call withdrawAll without reverting.
